rows.scope: VF06 REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING and SELF_HELP_STOP guidance only; preserve official PDF bytes and guard before final output replacement
rows.finding: VF06 found that the guide omitted the two controlling-record CORI actions and gave no participant stop/help instructions for four recorded conditions.
rows.correction: The guide now prints both exact controlling-record actions: obtain the participant's own CORI from DCJIS and check the docket against it, preserving the boundary that LegalEase never collects, inspects or authenticates CORI. It also prints a stop-and-get-help section naming all four registry conditions without deciding eligibility or treating court acts as prerequisites. The builder reads and cross-checks both controlling records and refuses before final writes when those disclosures are absent.
rows.countersNote: This guidance repair is not independent acceptance. VF06's other thirteen PASS findings and any repaired output require independent review under the normal gates.
rows.grantsNothing: No verdict, owner adoption, route change or commercial authority.
